notes: WooCommerce-based listings site. Successfully extracts price (100%) and location (100%) from 101 listings. Title, link, and image fields appear to be JavaScript-rendered (Fusion/Avada theme dynamic content) and return null/empty in static HTML. For complete data extraction, JavaScript rendering (Playwright/Selenium) is required. Location data includes state/city information. Prices range from $175,000 to $3,650,000+.
